issues.title: Ministry of Transport makes headway in restructuring Malawi Railways (1994) Limited
issues.title_en: Ministry of Transport makes headway in restructuring Malawi Railways (1994) Limited
issues.summary: * Invites professionals to apply for three crucial director positions of engineering, corporate and finance services * Malawi Railways is a government corporation that ran the national rail network until privatisation in 1999 * From December 1, 1999, Mozambican Central East African Railways (CEAR) led by Railroad Development Corporation won the bid to operate the network Analysis by Duncan Mlanjira As the country moves forward to rejuvenate the country’s rail transport system, the Ministry of Transport & Public Works is restructuring the Malawi Railways (1994) Limited, which was privatised in...

issues.title: Syria: No Clashes With Jordan, Only Regional Integration
issues.title_en: Syria: No Clashes With Jordan, Only Regional Integration
issues.summary: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Al-Shaibani said Saturday that Jordan and Syria have an integrated relationship across various sectors, stressing that there are no clashes or skirmishes between the two countries.
